title: Качество данных
semantics: parameters:{}; five fresh full outputs. Inputs: continuous or discrete integer/real, discrete string and boolean, continuous datetime. Default ports 0/3 preserve input, 1/2 can be empty despite summary counts. Fixed summary order N,DisplayName,DataType,DataKind,Null,Out,Extr,Avg,Moda,Median. Numeric Moda is histogram-based even for discrete numeric fields. Boolean Avg is true fraction, Median NULL, Moda frequency; date summary displays serial-day numbers. Input variant and continuous string are unsupported. Algorithm wizard and hidden MaxNullsPercent/actions UI are unavailable in 7.4.2; no hidden-setting or frozen-model apply parameters.

parameter_schema.description: Proposed profile still requires {}. Input: continuous integer/real/datetime, discrete integer/real/boolean/string. Read 0..4; no hidden actions or saved-model apply.
